text: あなたも　ファンクラブの　いちいんに　なりたいのかね？

structure.jp: ファンクラブの　いちいんに
structure.en: a member of the Fan Club
is it that you want to become?

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の before か asks for the reason behind what he sees: 'is it that...?'. かね is an older man's soft way to ask. なりたいのかね = 'is it that you want to become one?'

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.span: いちいんに　なりたい
patterns.explanation: に before なる shows what someone turns into. いちいんに　なりたい = 'want to become a member'

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on the end of a verb says someone wants to do it. なりたい = 'want to become'
